transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I came in because I’ve been feeling more tense and kind of down than I expected. I’ve been trying to clean up my image and my routine for some arts board stuff, and I’m still doing the basic things, but I keep dropping little things I normally care about—like fair planning notes or design drafts. Then I feel guilty about it and end up canceling plans instead of just catching up.
Do you feel anxious most of the time?

I wouldn’t say anxious all the time, but I have been more tense than usual. Since trying to get my image and routine together for the arts board stuff, I’m still handling the basics, but I keep slipping on smaller things I care about, like fair planning notes or design drafts. Then I feel guilty and end up canceling plans instead of just catching up.
Have you been feeling sad or empty most of the time?

Sad most of the time? Not exactly empty, no. I do feel more down than usual, especially since I started trying to get my image and routine together for the arts board stuff. I’m still doing the basic things, but I keep letting smaller things slip—like fair planning notes or design drafts—and then I feel guilty and cancel plans instead of just catching up.
Do you find yourself enjoying things you normally like to do?
I’m not really sure. I don’t think it’s that I can’t enjoy things at all, but I haven’t been paying close attention to it. Some things just feel harder to get myself to do lately.
Have you lost weight recently?
Not that I’ve noticed. My clothes seem to fit about the same, so I don’t think I’ve lost weight recently.
Are there things that you used to enjoy doing, but now you don't find pleasure in them?
I’m not sure. I wouldn’t say there’s anything I just can’t enjoy anymore. I think I’ve just been less motivated to start things, but once I’m doing them, I can still get some enjoyment out of it.
Do you find yourself avoiding certain activities or places because of your current mental state?

Yeah, a little. I’ve been canceling plans more than I normally would. Since I started trying to clean up my image and routine for the arts board stuff, I’ve been more tense and kind of down, and I’ll fall behind on little things like fair planning notes or design drafts. Then I feel guilty and avoid going out or dealing with people instead of just catching up.
Do you often worry about things that are coming up or things that might happen in the future?

Yeah, I do worry about what’s coming up. Since I started trying to clean up my image and routine for the arts board stuff, I’ve been more tense than I expected. I keep thinking about what I’m supposed to be doing, and then if I drop something small, like fair planning notes or design drafts, I feel guilty and end up canceling plans instead of catching up.
Do you often feel nervous or on edge?

Yes, I do feel on edge a lot lately. It’s not constant panic or anything, but since I started trying to clean up my image and routine for the arts board stuff, I’ve been more tense than I expected. I’m still doing the basics, but I keep dropping little things I normally care about, like the fair planning notes or design drafts, and then I feel guilty and end up canceling plans instead of just catching up.
Do you avoid certain activities or places because you fear something might happen or because you fear how you will feel?

Yeah, I think it’s more because I’m afraid of how I’ll feel. Like, if I’m already tense or down and I know I’ve fallen behind on little things, like fair planning notes or design drafts, I just feel guilty. Then I cancel plans instead of catching up or facing people. It’s not really one specific place I’m scared of.
Do you have trouble sleeping due to racing thoughts or worry?

I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed my sleep being a major problem because of racing thoughts. I might think about things a bit when I’m trying to settle down, but I wouldn’t say it’s keeping me up a lot.
Have you been avoiding social interactions more than usual?

Yes, more than usual. I’ve been canceling plans when I feel like I’ve fallen behind on things, like the fair notes or design drafts. It’s not that I don’t want to see people exactly, I just get tense and guilty, and then avoiding it feels easier than trying to catch up or explain myself.
Do you often have physical symptoms like a racing heart, sweating, or trembling when you feel anxious or on edge?
I haven’t really noticed that happening much. I mean, I can feel tense or on edge, but I don’t usually get things like shaking or sweating or my heart racing in a big way.
Do you feel like you're unable to experience a range of emotions like you used to?

I’m not sure. I don’t think I feel totally numb or anything like that. I still have different emotions, maybe just a bit more stressed or flat at times, but I wouldn’t say I’m unable to feel things like I used to.
Do you feel like you're unable to feel emotions as strongly as you used to?
I don’t think so, not really. I still feel things strongly sometimes. Maybe I’m a little more worn down or distracted than usual, but I wouldn’t say my emotions are muted or anything.
Do you feel like you've lost interest in activities that you once found pleasurable?

A little, yeah. I wouldn’t say I’ve stopped caring completely, but since I started trying to clean up my image and routine for the arts board stuff, I’ve been more tense and kind of down. I’m still doing the basics, but I keep dropping small things I normally care about, like fair planning notes or design drafts. Then I feel guilty and end up canceling plans instead of just catching up.
How long have you been feeling this way?
About two months, I think. It started around when I began trying to really overhaul my routine and how I present myself.
Has your current mental state significantly impacted your daily life or relationships?

Yeah, somewhat. I’m still managing basic errands and showing up for most commitments, but I haven’t been as reliable as I usually am. Mostly with volunteer and creative stuff people count on me for, like fair planning or following through on design work. I’ve let some things slide, and I think it’s affected how people see whether they can depend on me.
Have you had any significant change in your appetite over the past two months?
I haven’t really noticed a big change in my appetite, no. It’s been pretty much the same as usual, as far as I can tell.
Do you feel sad most of the day, nearly every day?

Not most of the day, nearly every day, no. I’ve been more tense and kind of down since I started trying to clean up my image and routine for the arts board stuff, but it comes and goes. I’m still doing the basic things, but I keep dropping little things I usually care about, like fair planning notes or design drafts, and then I feel guilty and cancel plans instead of catching up.
